title: Akai embraces open-source firmware for upcoming MPC Sample Key
excerpt: Akai is giving early access to hackers and custom firmware developers for the unannounced MPC Sample Key, featuring open-source firmware.
body_html:
Akai is leaning into the modding community by offering early device access for its upcoming MPC Sample Key, which has not yet been formally announced. The company is welcoming custom firmware developers and hackers to create modifications for the new hardware.

By choosing to provide open-source firmware, Akai is supporting community-driven software changes for the device. While the product launch details are still developing, early previews highlight custom modifications built by the community following this open-access initiative.
